streak_chain.title: Hunter's Flame
streak_chain.description: Maintain your daily quest streak. The Sovereign's flame must never go out.

streak_phoenix.title: Phoenix from the Ashes
streak_phoenix.description: Lost a streak of over 10 days and returned to 3 days again.

streak_scroll_save.title: Strategist
streak_scroll_save.description: Use the Rest Scroll to protect a streak of 7+ days.

focus_hours.title: Mental Fortress
focus_hours.description: Accumulate hours in Focus Mode. The Sovereign's mind knows no limits.

focus_sessions.title: Iron Discipline
focus_sessions.description: Complete Focus Mode sessions. The Sovereign trains the mind without stopping.

focus_hardcore_surrender.title: Cold Regret
focus_hardcore_surrender.description: You tried to exit Hardcore Focus Mode but went back in the confirmation modal.

focus_crimson_knight.title: Throne Conquered
focus_crimson_knight.description: Complete the Boss challenge "The Knight's Vow" (90 min focus).

focus_long_session.title: Ultra Focus
focus_long_session.description: Complete a Focus Mode session lasting 2 or more hours.

boss_slayer.title: Dungeon Terror
boss_slayer.description: Defeat Boss Raids. The legend of the Shadow Sovereign spreads across the realm.

boss_runner.title: The Venom Can't Catch Me
boss_runner.description: Complete the Boss "Viper's Venom" (5km GPS run).

boss_omega_slayer.title: Short Circuit
boss_omega_slayer.description: Complete the Boss "Omega Weapon (S-Rank)" proving your insane resilience.

boss_eclipse_survivor.title: Void Survivor
boss_eclipse_survivor.description: Complete the Boss "Cosmic Eclipse (S-Rank)". You absorbed pure knowledge under pressure.

boss_seraph_fall.title: Broken Golden Angel
boss_seraph_fall.description: Complete the Boss "Fallen Seraph Blade (S-Rank)". You bent sacred light with your Shadow.

boss_archlich_prime.title: Archlich's Crown
boss_archlich_prime.description: Complete the Boss "Primordial Archlich (S-Rank)". The ancient ritual now obeys the Sovereign.

boss_soul_reaper.title: Void Reaper
boss_soul_reaper.description: Complete the Boss "Soul Reaper (S-Rank)". No essence escapes you.

boss_astral_nebula.title: King of Nebulae
boss_astral_nebula.description: Complete the Boss "Nebula King (S-Rank)". You walked among stars without faltering.

dungeon_break_hunter.title: Portal Defender
dungeon_break_hunter.description: Stop Dungeon Breaks. Chaos has no place where the Sovereign treads.

event_halloween_reaper.title: Autumn Reaper
event_halloween_reaper.description: Defeat the Halloween event Boss. The mist parts for the Sovereign.

event_winter_lich.title: Solstice Crown
event_winter_lich.description: Defeat the Winter event Boss. The longest night bowed.

event_summer_titan.title: Solar Fury
event_summer_titan.description: Defeat the Summer event Boss. The extreme heat strengthened your will.

event_new_year_ashen.title: Reborn from Ashes
event_new_year_ashen.description: Defeat the New Year Boss. The new beginning was sealed by your shadow.

event_valentine_oath.title: Crimson Oath
event_valentine_oath.description: Defeat the Valentine Boss. The promise was engraved in the System.

event_carnival_mask.title: Mask of Chaos
event_carnival_mask.description: Defeat the Carnival Boss. Chaos danced in your favor.

event_equinox_guardian.title: Guardian of Balance
event_equinox_guardian.description: Defeat the Equinox Boss. You maintained perfect balance.

event_easter_hare.title: Easter Leap
event_easter_hare.description: Defeat the Easter Boss. The leap of light was yours.

event_spring_bloom.title: Flower of Rebirth
event_spring_bloom.description: Defeat the Spring Boss. Life bloomed in your path.

event_harvest_king.title: King of the Harvest
event_harvest_king.description: Defeat the Harvest Boss. Abundance belongs to the Sovereign.

event_black_friday_merchant.title: Shadow Merchant
event_black_friday_merchant.description: Defeat the Black Friday Boss. The gold obeys.

event_yule_seraph.title: Yule Seraph
event_yule_seraph.description: Defeat the Yule Boss. The sacred night yielded.

event_midnight_wraith.title: Midnight Wraith
event_midnight_wraith.description: Defeat the Long Nights Boss. The darkness no longer controls you.

event_festival_drake.title: Festival Drake
event_festival_drake.description: Defeat the Festival Boss. The flame celebrated with you.

level_chain.title: Hunter's Ascension
level_chain.description: Increase your level. The Shadow Sovereign's power knows no ceiling.

secret_monarch.title: Shadow Sovereign
secret_monarch.description: Reach Level 20. The title of Shadow Sovereign is officially granted by the System.

shadow_army.title: Shadow Army
shadow_army.description: Collect shadows for your army. The Sovereign commands them all.

shadow_elite.title: Shadow Vanguard
shadow_elite.description: Have 3 or more shadows simultaneously active on the battlefield.

quests_perfect.title: Flawless
quests_perfect.description: Complete every day without failing a quest. The System observes your discipline.

quests_total.title: Unstoppable Warrior
quests_total.description: Complete daily quests in total. Each quest forges the Sovereign.

quests_perfect_week.title: Perfect Week
quests_perfect_week.description: Complete all quests for an entire week.

extra_quest_chain.title: Field Agent
extra_quest_chain.description: Complete Extra Quests in total. The Sovereign is not limited by the System.

extra_quest_daily_all.title: The Hunter's Agenda
extra_quest_daily_all.description: Complete ALL available Extra Quests in a single day.

login_chain.title: Sovereign's Presence
login_chain.description: Open the app daily. The System records your consistency over time.

economy_first_purchase.title: Consumer Hunter
economy_first_purchase.description: Buy your first item at the System Shop.

economy_system_pass.title: Expensive Privilege
economy_system_pass.description: Use the System Pass to skip a daily quest.

economy_lagrima_clutch.title: Resurrection
economy_lagrima_clutch.description: Use the Tear of Purification while a penalty is active.

economy_reloj.title: Time is Gold
economy_reloj.description: Use the Hourglass Watch during a Boss Raid.

economy_hoarder.title: The System Miser
economy_hoarder.description: Accumulate 5000 Gold without spending. The System notes your infinite patience.

economy_spender.title: Invest in the System
economy_spender.description: Spend 3000 Gold total at the Shop over time.

economy_big_spender.title: System Patron
economy_big_spender.description: Spend gold at the shop in total. The System thrives with your dedication.

clutch_last_minute.title: On the Brink of Death
clutch_last_minute.description: Complete the last daily quest with less than 30 minutes to midnight.

clutch_late_night.title: Ignoring the System
clutch_late_night.description: Complete the last daily quest between 23:30 and 23:59.

clutch_undo_redo.title: Committed to Precision
clutch_undo_redo.description: Undo a quest and complete it again on the same day.

rebellion_spam.title: Rebellion
rebellion_spam.description: You tried to open a blocked app 5 times in less than 1 minute. The System notes your weakness.

rebellion_resist.title: Temptation Resisted
rebellion_resist.description: You tried to open a blocked app and gave up. The System approves.

rebellion_c_rank.title: S-Rank Luck
rebellion_c_rank.description: The roulette assigns Rank C to your first Side Quest.

penalty_first.title: Punished by the System
penalty_first.description: You enter the Penalty Zone for the first time. The System expected more.

penalty_cleared.title: Redemption
penalty_cleared.description: Clear an active penalty (by any means).

penalty_comeback.title: Resurgence
penalty_comeback.description: Complete all quests the day after an active penalty.

penalty_veteran.title: Void Veteran
penalty_veteran.description: You survived 5 penalties and came back stronger. The void does not consume you.

secret_first_day.title: The Journey Begins
secret_first_day.description: Complete all quests on your first day as a hunter.

secret_all_bosses.title: Complete Hunter
secret_all_bosses.description: Complete one boss of each type: GPS (Viper), Focus (Knight) and Training (Cerberus).

perfect_week_1.title: Golden Week
perfect_week_1.description: An entire week of completed quests without failures.
